tei:div.tei:p: smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyud bzhugs so/

na mo gu ru bhe/ smad 'dul du grags pa'i bshad rgyud ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas te/ 'khor kun dga' bo dang*/ sha ni'i gos can/ nyer sbas dhi dhi ka nag po legs mthong*/ blo gros mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ shā kya 'od/ chos kyi gshes gnyen/ che chung gnyis/ de gnyis kas seng ge gdong can/ des dha na shi la dang*/ dzī na mi bkra/ des lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yor dge byung dang | gtsang rab bsal/ dmar shā kya mu ne gsum la bshad/ de gsum mdo smad du byon nas/ a mes bla chen dgong pa rab bsal la bshad/ des slob ma la snga ba khams kyi zog po mi drug bya ba byung te/ ya gong ye shes srung dang*/ par rin chen gsal/ 'al rdo rje dbang phyug snub phag shi ra/ jo bo ye shes seng ge lcog ro shes rab byang chub rnams yin pa/ dang po mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas/ bsnyen rdzogs ma grub/ dge tshul yin/ 'dul ba la sogs chos rnams ni gnang | bla chen gyi bon po'i thugs zhen du byas nas/ zha theb kyi mu thugs sngon por byed pa sogs kyi/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba yang khong drug po la gnang par byed do/ /yang bar gnyis kyi slob ma/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des grum g.yag grung rgyal mtshan shing lag can la/ des dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'i nang nas/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab la 'dul ba bshad/ des bzung rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ de nas rim pa bzhin du/ snel bo grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rgya dbang rdor/ bya brtson 'grus 'bar/ rtsigs pa gzhon bzang*/ snyer chung bzang ston/ de la shā kya'i dge slong thub pa shes rab bdag gi 'dul ba'i chos skor rnams tshang mar zhus pa legs so/ /yang grub shing lag can gyis/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ tshong tshun shes rab seng ge sum pa ye shes blo gros/ a btsun shā kya rgyal mtshan/ 'dre ston tshul khrims gzhon nu rnams la/ 'dul ba bshad nas dbus gtsang du dar bar mdzad pa rnams la'ang*/

smad 'dul zer cing | bshad rgyud rang rang na gsal lo/ /smad 'dul bshad rgyud 'di bris dge ba yis/ /'dul khrims gtsang zhing 'chad nyan dar bar shog /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyud/ -PAGE 258--PAGE 257-
